visual_action: A montage of scenic B-roll clips featuring bodies of water with a prominent blue color. Scenes include a tropical beach with turquoise water and palm trees, whales or dolphins breaching the surface of the ocean, waves crashing on a white sand beach, and aerial shots of tropical coastlines.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The on-screen text "how a blue wave on election night feels" uses the common political term "blue wave" to refer to a major electoral victory for the Democratic Party.

on_screen_text.text: how a blue wave on election night feels

spoken_summary: The lyrics sung are "You make me feel, like I'm alive again."
audio_music: An upbeat, euphoric electronic pop track plays throughout the video, creating a celebratory and joyful mood.
editing_pacing: The video is a montage with relatively quick cuts between different scenic clips.
central_claim: A major Democratic electoral victory feels serene, beautiful, and life-affirming.
intended_effect: To make viewers associate the Democratic Party with feelings of joy, peace, and renewal, and to encourage support for a "blue wave."
